scope: Raw spike/trial-level Chen reanalysis plus a frozen numerical external replication in CRCNS alm-3.
confirmatory_language: The alm-3 numerical pipeline is frozen before extracting the replication statistics on this branch, but the Li et al. 2016 publication and its qualitative conclusions are public and known. This is therefore a frozen numerical external replication, not an outcome-blind preregistration. Chen is a de novo raw-data reanalysis of a system whose published conclusions and prior processed-figure analysis are already known.

common_population_code.time_window: Final 400 ms before the go cue (CueTime).
common_population_code.training_trials: Correct, good, non-photostimulation control trials only.
common_population_code.choice_direction: Within each training fold, CD = mean population spike-count vector on correct right trials minus mean vector on correct left trials, normalized to unit Euclidean norm.
common_population_code.cross_fitted_auc: Five stratified folds when each class has at least 5 correct control trials; otherwise the maximum feasible number of folds >=2. Test-trial CD projections are pooled across folds and AUC is oriented so larger values mean better separation of correct right versus correct left trials.
common_population_code.recovery_projection: A separate CD is fit on all eligible correct control trials only, then applied without refitting to perturbation trials. Choice separation is mean CD projection for right-condition trials minus mean projection for left-condition trials.

chen.raw_input: session-level data_structure_*.mat spike/trial objects; no published figure coordinates are used to construct the raw predictors or raw outcomes
chen.direct_primary_predictor: Control-trial bilateral choice-code coupling: separate left/right control-trained CDs are applied to simultaneous control trials in the final 400 ms before the go cue; Spearman correlation of left/right projections is calculated across both trial conditions and averaged across eligible standard-task sessions within mouse.
direct_primary_outcomes: Raw neuronal recovery after unilateral ALM photoinhibition: end-of-delay choice separation on the perturbed hemisphere along the control-trained CD divided by matched control choice separation, computed separately for left- and right-ALM perturbation.
Raw behavioral recovery after unilateral ALM photoinhibition: balanced photoinhibition accuracy divided by balanced control accuracy, computed separately by intervention side.
chen.direct_primary_test: Mouse-level Spearman association of bilateral control-trial coupling with each side-specific recovery outcome, using 500,000 mouse-label permutations and leave-one-mouse-out linear prediction. Right and left intervention directions are reported separately rather than pooled because the published system is directionally asymmetric.
chen.transferable_predictor: Control-trial local population choice-code strength in the final 400 ms before the go cue, defined by the frozen common cross-fitted AUC. This predictor is computed without perturbation trials and is the metric frozen for external transfer to alm-3.
chen.eligibility: Standard-task simultaneous bilateral ALM sessions; putative pyramidal units; >5 simultaneously recorded units in each hemisphere for the direct bilateral analysis and >5 trials per required condition; mouse is the inferential unit.

alm3_external_replication.dataset: Li, Daie, Svoboda & Druckmann 2016 Nature; CRCNS alm-3, DOI 10.6080/K0RB72JW
alm3_external_replication.input: Processed session MATLAB objects containing sorted spike times, trial identities, behavior, and photostimulation types; raw voltage traces are not required.
alm3_external_replication.population: Mice/sessions with simultaneous electrophysiology and photoinhibition, excluding callosotomy conditions and source-documented do-not-analyze photostimulation codes.
alm3_external_replication.primary_predictor: Control-trial local population choice-code strength in the final 400 ms before the go cue, defined identically to the transferable Chen predictor by the frozen common cross-fitted AUC using putative pyramidal units.
alm3_external_replication.primary_outcome: Neuronal recovery after ipsilateral early-delay photoinhibition (PhotostimulationType 4): choice separation along the control-trained CD in the final 400 ms before the go cue divided by matched control choice separation. The ratio is computed within session and averaged within mouse.
alm3_external_replication.secondary_outcome: Behavioral recovery for PhotostimulationType 4: balanced percent-correct on photoinhibition trials divided by balanced percent-correct on matched control trials, averaged within mouse.
alm3_external_replication.negative_control: Contralateral early-delay photoinhibition (PhotostimulationType 5) is analyzed separately as a direction/control condition and is not substituted for the locked primary outcome.
alm3_external_replication.inferential_unit: Mouse. Session-level results are descriptive/repeated measures only.
alm3_external_replication.primary_statistic: Spearman rank correlation across mouse means between the frozen control-only predictor and neuronal recovery.
alm3_external_replication.permutation_test: 500,000 one-sided mouse-label permutations with seed 20261012; if the eligible mouse count is <=9, all label permutations are enumerated instead.
alm3_external_replication.success_criterion: Primary Spearman rho > 0 with one-sided permutation P < 0.05, plus positive leave-one-mouse-out R2. Failure of either criterion is reported as a failed external replication.
alm3_external_replication.uncertainty: 50,000 mouse bootstrap resamples for a percentile 95% interval for Spearman rho.
alm3_external_replication.missingness_rule: No imputation. A mouse contributes only if it has at least one session with finite predictor and primary outcome; all eligible sessions are averaged equally within mouse.
alm3_external_replication.multiplicity: Only the neuronal-recovery association is primary. Behavioral recovery, contralateral perturbation, session-level associations, alternative time windows, and alternative decoders are secondary or sensitivity analyses and cannot replace the primary result.
